protocol.title: Droplet-Based High-Throughput Cultivation for Accurate Screening of Antibiotic Resistant Gut Microbes
protocol.platform: Anaerobic droplet microfluidics (flow-focusing droplet generation + dielectrophoretic sorting) inside vinyl anaerobic chamber
protocol.microbiome_source: Human fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) donor stool (Lee et al. 2017)
protocol.objective: High-throughput anaerobic isolation and cultivation of gut microbes in picoliter droplets, wavelet-OD-based slow-grower sorting, and droplet-based antibiotic resistance screening of FMT donor stool

atmosphere.H2S_column: Coy hydrogen sulfide reducing column (prevents corrosion of electronics)

components_inside_chamber: Microfluidic devices (droplet generation and droplet sorting)
Syringe pumps (Harvard Apparatus Pump 11 Pico Plus Elite)
device.connection: Sealed rubber ports for power and control wires

droplet_generation.fabrication: Soft lithography; SU-8 3050 on 4-inch silicon wafer; PDMS (RTV 615) 10:1 A:B; cured 80 C >=1h; plasma bonded to glass slide
droplet_generation.oil_phase: Bio-Rad Droplet Generation Oil for EvaGreen

droplet_sorting.fabrication: Same as generation device; plasma bonded to glass slide with conductive indium-tin oxide (Delta Technologies Part No. CG-811N-S207)
droplet_sorting.electrodes: Low-melting-temperature solder (Indium Corporation 51% In/32.5% Bi/16.5% Sn) flowed into electrode holes at 90 C; connected to standard wires

imaging_and_control.electrode_control: NI-DAQ 6211 analog output -> TREK Model 2220 amplifier (200 V/V)

wavelet_od_sorting.method: Discrete wavelet frame decomposition (LabView IMAQ Extract Texture Feature VI)
wavelet_od_sorting.normalization: Non-zero elements in wavelet feature vector normalized to 1
wavelet_od_sorting.detection_region: Interior of droplet (~6080 pixels) between red-dot markers at sorting junction

reagents.carrier_oil: Bio-Rad Droplet Generation Oil for EvaGreen

BHIS.composition: 500 mL water + 18.5 g BHI Broth (Sigma) + 2.5 g yeast extract + 0.25 g L-cysteine; autoclaved; +0.5 mL 0.1% Vitamin K in 95% ethanol + 0.5 mL hemin solution (5 mg/mL in 0.1 M NaOH, filter-sterilised)

BHIS_ASF.composition: BHIS + 5% newborn calf serum + 5% sheep serum + 5% horse serum (all sera from Fisher Scientific)
BHIS_ASF.use: Validation with ASF model mouse gut microbiota

YCFA.composition: 10 g casitone, 2.5 g yeast extract, 5 g dextrose (D-glucose), 0.045 g MgSO4.7H2O, 0.09 g CaCl2.2H2O, 0.45 g K2HPO4, 0.45 g KH2PO4, 0.9 g NaCl, 0.001 g resazurin sodium salt, 1.9 mL acetic acid, 0.7 mL propionic acid, 90 uL iso-butyric acid, 100 uL n-valeric acid, 100 uL iso-valeric acid, 500 mL DI water; boil 10 min stirring; cool; add 4 g NaHCO3 + 0.5 g L-cysteine-HCl + 0.01 g hemin + 0.0025 g mucin; adjust to 990 mL; pH 6.7-6.8; autoclave; +10 mL filter-sterilised vitamin solution
YCFA.vitamin_solution_per_litre: 2 mg biotin, 2 mg folic acid, 12 mg pyridoxine-HCl, 4.5 mg thiamine-HCl, 5 mg riboflavin, 5 mg nicotinic acid, 5 mg D-Ca-pantothenate, 0.1 mg vitamin B12, 5 mg p-aminobenzoic acid, 5 mg DL-thioctic acid

reagents.dna_extraction: Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (manufacturer instructions)
reagents.dna_free_water: Used for sorted droplet demulsification (150 uL per sample)

stool_sample.donor_type: Previously characterised FMT donor (Lee et al. 2017)
stool_sample.ethics: University of Chicago Ethics Committee and IRB (IRB 132-0212); written informed consent obtained
stool_sample.preparation: 50 mL stool diluted in 100 mL PBS; supernatant collected by centrifugation; stored at -80 C
stool_sample.viability_method: Live/Dead BacLight kit (ThermoFisher); note: oxygenation required for dye fluorescence may introduce measurement artefact
stool_sample.plate_inoculation: 100 uL suspension spread per plate; ~1 cell/500 um2 (bacterial lawn density to ensure rare cells are plated)
stool_sample.droplet_dilution: 200x; Poisson mean 2-12% droplets contain one live cell (accounting for cell density uncertainty and droplet volume range)

sequencing.facility: Environmental Sample Preparation and Sequencing Facility, Argonne National Laboratory
sequencing.read_processing: illumina-utils (Eren et al. 2013a): demultiplex, join paired-end, quality filter (min overlap 45 nt; max 2 mismatches in overlap region; resolved by higher-quality base)
sequencing.asv_inference: Minimum Entropy Decomposition (MED) v2.1 via oligotyping pipeline (Eren et al. 2015a); Shannon entropy-based iterative decomposition to amplicon sequence variants (ASVs)
sequencing.asv_filtering: Conservative dead/nonviable DNA filtering: threshold fitted per sample; 90% CI by MLE (binomial model); ASVs below lower CI limit discarded (Source code 1)

sanger_sequencing.master_mix: GoTaq Green Master Mix (Promega), 250 nM primers, 2 uL DNA, 7 uL DNA-free water (10 uL total)
sanger_sequencing.gel: 2% agarose; band excised; purified with QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit (Qiagen)
sanger_sequencing.facility: University of Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center DNA Sequencing and Genotyping Facility
sanger_sequencing.alignment: MAFFT algorithm (Benchling); NCBI Standard Nucleotide BLAST for taxonomy

steps.name: Fecal cell encapsulation in BHIS droplets
steps.poisson_loading: 200x dilution; 2-12% droplets contain one live cell
steps.notes: mix abstracts the two-pump flow-focusing droplet generation event (aqueous cell+medium sheared into oil phase). Stochastic single-cell isolation eliminates competitive overgrowth of fast-growers.

steps.name: BHIS droplet incubation
steps.notes: Droplet volume reduces after ~4 days due to evaporation in arid anaerobic atmosphere; cultures limited to 2 days. Plates cultured up to 7 days (10080 min) in parallel for comparison.

steps.name: BHIS demulsification, DNA extraction, and 16S sequencing
operations: Mix emulsion with equal volume PFO; vortex + centrifuge; remove oil and PFO
For sorted droplets: add 150 uL DNA-free water + 150 uL PFO first (sorted volume ~1-10 uL)
Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit DNA extraction
detect sixteenSrRNASequencing (abstracts Illumina MiSeq 2x151 V4 amplicon pipeline)

steps.name: Fecal cell encapsulation in GMM droplets
steps.notes: GMM: Goodman et al. 2011. Notable: Bacteroidetes and Proteobacteria underrepresented on GMM and YCFA plates; abolished in droplets.

steps.name: Fecal cell encapsulation in YCFA droplets
steps.notes: YCFA shows highest richness increase (up to 410%) over plates. Many Firmicutes dominate YCFA plates (competitive advantage); droplets restore phyla-broad representation.

steps.name: Ampicillin resistance screening in BHIS droplets
steps.post_incubation_sort: waveletODSorting removes empty/non-viable droplets before DNA extraction

results.notes: Pseudomonas contains opportunistic pathogens. Shewanella is a progenitor of antibiotic resistance genes in humans (Yousfi et al. 2017).

steps.name: Ciprofloxacin resistance screening in BHIS droplets
steps.post_incubation_sort: waveletODSorting removes empty/non-viable droplets before DNA extraction

results.plate_preferred: 4 Clostridium spp. showed higher growth on plates than droplets
results.notes: Fluoroquinolone class. Gram-positive bacteria show reduced susceptibility (Poole 2000). Snydman et al. 2017 for Bacteroides/Parabacteroides fluoroquinolone resistance.

steps.name: Vancomycin resistance screening in BHIS droplets
steps.post_incubation_sort: waveletODSorting removes empty/non-viable droplets before DNA extraction

known_resistors_both_platforms: Enterobacteriaceae gen. spp. (intrinsic resistance; Citron et al. 2012)

key_results.bacteroides_oligotyping: Droplet cultures cluster closer to raw stool than plate cultures (multiscale bootstrap resampling, p<0.005)
key_results.asv_filtering_note: 41 ASVs detected in cultures not present in raw stool; require increased read count to resolve true abundance

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 22 basic blocks (BB1-BB22), 5 if/else gates per protocol arm (2 cultivation QC + 3 antibiotic screen), 28 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations converted to minutes (m) for compiler compatibility (BioScript supports s and m only; h token not supported)

duration_conversions.7_days_plate_culture_context_only: 10080m (not encoded; plates are parallel off-chip comparator)

compiler_constraint_notes: No array indexing or multi-unit splits used (avoids lilott8 compiler array zipping failure modes noted in moazami reference)
All emulsion variables are scalar; all downstream ops are strict 1-to-1
dispose used for pass paths; drain used for fail paths throughout
All QC signals explicitly disposed before terminal NOP in BB22
bhisEmulsion promoted to bhisEmulsion2[0] by compiler SSA renaming when crossing BB1->BB4 join; correct behaviour
Terminal BB22 emits NOP as expected lilott8 exit node marker
bioscript_compiler_notes.biological_scope_note: This .bs file encodes both Protocol 1 (rich media cultivation: BHIS with slow-grower sorting, GMM, YCFA) and Protocol 2 (antibiotic resistance screening: ampicillin, ciprofloxacin, vancomycin). Plate-based parallel cultures are off-chip comparators and are not encoded in BioScript.
